The Company’s proportion of net sales by disaggregated revenue source was generally consistent for each reportable segment in Note 10, “Segment Information” for the three- and nine-month periods ended June 27, 2026 and June 28, 2025, except in Greater China, where iPhone revenue represented a moderately higher proportion of net sales.
As of June 27, 2026 and September 27, 2025, the Company had total deferred revenue of $14.9 billion and $13.7 billion, respectively. As of June 27, 2026, the Company expects 64% of total deferred revenue to be realized in less than a year, 23% within one-to-two years, 11% within two-to-three years and 2% in greater than three years.
